scene: At 08:23 Maddoc arrived at Tansyhook Crossing from the Rillbend culvert, leaving the small moss-feathered seed-eating creature alone. Maddoc has not approached or spoken to anyone here.
summary: After leaving the small seed-eating creature beneath the Rillbend culvert, Maddoc walked 16 minutes to Tansyhook Crossing (08:23). No other outcomes, resource or relationship changes.
